title: Note-list read failure is presented as an empty list
reproduction: Open Notes while signed in with the selected device organization set.
Make the notes SELECT return a Supabase error (for example, deny the read or make the network unavailable).
Observe Notes after the query settles.
expected: The query failure is visibly distinct from a successful empty result, with an available recovery action or clear retry guidance.
actual: listMyNotes logs the error and returns []; NotesView receives a successful query result and renders NotesList, which says ‘No notes yet’ with no error state.
severity: S3: notes query failure is indistinguishable from a genuinely empty collection
priority: P1: user cannot tell whether their notes are absent or the read failed
verification_status: Source-derived reproducible sequence; native and regression verification pending.
